name: deterministic-copy
description: Offline family B SVG example; stacked text panels, no generated illustration.

brief.headline: COPY YOU CAN CHECK
brief.subtitle: AUTHORED ONCE. PRESERVED IN THE ARTIFACT.

sections.heading: 01 - AUTHOR
lines: Every title, heading and body line comes from the recipe.
Keep punctuation: <copy> & "quotes" stay exactly as authored.

sections.heading: 02 - VERIFY
lines: Wrapped lines retain every character, including spaces.
Overflow fails before publication. Nothing is silently removed.

sections.heading: 03 - REVIEW
lines: Text values are deterministic. Font appearance depends on the viewer.
Diagrams and unsupported layouts need a separate design.

brief.footer: NO PROVIDER CALL. NO GENERATED LETTERING.
